blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — All individuals arrested during a protest demonstration in Muntinlupa City were finally released on Monday. This is after the Muntinlupa City prosecutor’s office dismissed complaints of malicious mischief against the arrested individuals. These persons detained include 236 members of Lakbayan ng Timog Katagalugan. Government lawyers cited lack of prima facie evidence. READ:
